sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY,
THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed under Section 54(2) of the Land Acquisition Act by the Deputy Chief Engineer,
South Western Railways, challenging the judgment and award dated 18.10.2020 passed by the VI Additional District Judge, Tumakuru, in R.A.No.150/2019, whereby the appeal filed by the appellant is dismissed.

2. The brief facts of the case are that the first respondent herein is the owner of the land measuring 1800 sq.ft. in Municipal Katha No.388, Sy.No.39, situated at Mallaghatta village, Kasaba Hobli,
Kunigal Taluk.

The said land has been acquired for the formation of Bangalore - Hassan railway line, whereupon the proceedings under the Land Acquisition Act has been initiated, preliminary notification has been issued on 18.01.2007, which was NC: 2023:KHC:33396 followed by a final notification dated 01.11.2007 and the award was passed on 12.02.2009, by which a sum of Rs.90,000/- along with solatium and other amount has been awarded.
Being aggrieved by the same, the landowner sought for reference before the civil court.
The Reference Court by order dated 23.09.2017 enhanced the compensation amount to Rs.250/- per sq. ft.
Being aggrieved by the same, the railways filed an appeal before the IV Additional District Judge, Tumakuru in RA No.150/2019.
The appellate court dismissed the appeal, confirming the order passed by the Reference Court dated 23.09.2017.
Being aggrieved by the same, railways filed this appeal.

3. The learned counsel appearing for the appellant submitted that in respect of the similarly situated land, a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in MFA No.2126/2017 C/w.MFA No.127/2021 dated 05.06,2023, following the judgment of a Division Bench of this Court in MFA No.2207/2016 dated 28.09.2021, fixed the compensation NC: 2023:KHC:33396 at Rs.200/- per sq. ft.
The order passed by the Division Bench of this Court has attained finality.

5. With the above observations, the appeal stands disposed of.
